study: prompt-58 adverse-movement prediction research (offline only; live Simulator, scanner, database, balance and slots untouched)
data: same SHA256-hashed Binance USD-M futures 1m last+mark klines, funding and open-interest archives as prompt-57 (raw-file-hashes.json in research/prompt-57)

trading.target: +25% net margin ROI after 0.05% taker fee and 0.02% slippage per side
trading.fills: open of 1m bar starting 60 s after the 5m close, as prompt-57

labels.sample: every 5m close, every coin, both sides, first 300 bars excluded for warmup
labels.adverse_price: 1m mark-price extreme vs fill price; same-minute tie counted as adverse
labels.y: target trigger reached on last price before the adverse threshold, within 24 h (unresolved = not target-first)

features: computed only from bars closed at or before the 5m signal close (feat58.py). Liquidation-cluster data: no reliable free historical source exists (Binance forceOrder is live-only and sampled), so it is NOT tested and is reported as untested.
model: L2 logistic regression per threshold, standardised on development only, fitted on development only; calibration checked on validation and out-of-sample (Brier, log loss, AUC, 10-bin reliability)

approach_C.entry: at each 5m close rank all 12 coins x 2 sides by predicted P(target-first | adverse a); enter the best while p >= p_min and portfolio gates allow
approach_C.emergency_exit: close when price adverse move reaches a (k = a x 75 margin units)
approach_C.selection: development portfolio net used only to discard configs with < 40 dev trades; choose by VALIDATION net; freeze to selection-frozen.json before reading out-of-sample

baseline: 100 random-entry seeds, same costs/exits, portfolio and per-trade
walk_forward: train 28 d / test 14 d / step 14 d, model refit each fold with the frozen configuration
pass_criteria: positive net after costs in validation AND out-of-sample
no account liquidation in validation or out-of-sample under the approach's own exit
out-of-sample net per trade above the random baseline 95th percentile
out-of-sample AUC of the chosen threshold model > 0.55 with 95% CI excluding 0.5
profitable on >= 7 of 12 coins out-of-sample is reported; trade frequency reported, no forced minimum
